name: Premium Small Breeds Adult Dry Dog Food

variants.name: Chicken 14 kg
variants.about_this_item: ADVANTAGES: 23/12 – a well-balanced formula for everyday feeding 100% quality animal protein Optimum pellet for dogs of small breeds A mixture of tocopherols as a natural antioxidant Vitamins D3, E, B1, B5, microelements and amino acids Omega 3 + Omega 6 for healthy skin and shiny coat INTEGRAMIX formula: dried tomatoes, ginger, hawthorn and bananas - for pet’s general health and strong immunity Without artificial flavors and colours
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: COMPOSITION: chicken meal 29 %, rice, maize, barley, poultry fat (preserved with tocopherols), hydrolyzed animal protein, maize gluten, sugar beet pulp, minerals, salmon oil 0,5 %, linseed 0,5 %, brewery yeast, banana* 0,23 %, tomatoes* 0,2 %, hawthorn* 0,065 %, ginger* 0,01 %.

Analytical constituents: ANALYTICAL CONSTITUENTS: crude protein 26 %, сrude fat 14 %, crude ash 6,3 %, crude fibre 2,2 %, calcium 1,3 %, phosphorus 1 %, omega-3 fatty acids 0,38 %, omega-6 fatty acids 3,02 %.

Additives: ADDITIVES (per 1 kg of product): Vitamin A (3а672а): 12 000 IU, Vitamin D3 (3а671): 960 IU, Vitamin E (3а700): 320 mg, Vitamin K3 (3а710): 5,2 mg, vitamin B1 (3а820): 2,39 mg, vitamin B2 (riboflavin): 7,28 mg, calcium-D-pantothenate (3a841): 18,98 mg, niacin (3a314): 23,64 mg, vitamin B6 (3а831): 2,8 mg, folic acid (3а316): 0,42 mg, vitamin B12 (cyanocobalamin): 0,167 mg, biotin (3а880): 0,095 mg, choline chloride (3а890) 60 %: 4,56 g; compounds of trace elements: zinc (3b604): 197,55 mg, copper (3b405): 21,15 mg, selenium (3b801): 0,15 mg, antioxidants, preservative permitted in the EU. *Natural ingredients, dried. Metabolizable energy per 100 g of pet food: 1 586,87 kJ (379,27 kcal).
